newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak blue chips mixed, SAX firms 1.43 points.
newsitem.headline: Slovak blue chips mixed, SAX firms 1.43 points.

text.p: Slovak blue chips closed mixed in moderate trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Tuesday, while gains to steel maker VSZ pushed the SAX index up 1.43 points to 206.13.
Brokers said that despite Tuesday's gain, the market showed signs of running out of steam sometime soon.
"If this trend continues, then we should expect flat, or even downward trend in the near future," Peter Krutil of Creditanstalt said.
VSZ closed up 15 crowns at 665, with 1,484 traded shares. Oil refinery Slovnaft did not trade on Tuesday. Oil and gas storage company Nafta fell 50 crowns to 1,920, with 187 traded shares.
"At the moment, there is silence around the blue chips, which boosted trading in recent weeks, as is seen also from the very low volumes of traded shares," Krutil added.
Overall volume increased to 484,258 shares, from 381,572 shares traded on Monday, while turnover rose to 565.33 million crowns, from 330.74 million.
